title: console: a member opening an app they may not access at its package-id URL gets "This app can't be opened" instead of the access-denied screen — the access probe asks the by-name route with the package id and reads its 404 as not found
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render · A2

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (console app shell). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "console app access probe package id URL segment access denied screen unreachable shows app not found for member Setup" — 2 hits, neither this shape (objectui#4473, objectui#2794, both closed).

**Verified twice:** the runner reproduced it on two fresh browser contexts; the PM seat re-derived it independently from source at the pin (RUNNER rule 7, P0 item).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 / PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23110), stock `examples/app-showcase`, `--seed-admin`, member persona `phone.demo@example.com` (positions `org_member`, `everyone`).

## Reproduction

1. Sign in through the console form as the member; `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` answers 200 for that user.
2. Navigate to `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup` — the package-id URL segment the admin's own Setup links use (ADR-0048 URL form).
3. Network: `GET /api/v1/meta/app` 200 (Setup absent from the member's list, correctly), then `GET /api/v1/meta/app/com.objectstack.setup` → **404** `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
4. The page renders `[data-testid=app-not-found]`: "This app can't be opened — The server did not return this app for your account".

**Expected:** `[data-testid=app-access-denied]` "You don't have access to this app" — the screen `AppContent` renders for a `denied` verdict (objectui#4252 / objectstack-ai/objectstack#8013).
**Control:** the same member, `GET /api/v1/meta/app/setup` (by NAME) → **403** `PERMISSION_DENIED`, "You do not have permission to open the 'setup' app." No Setup content leaks either way; this is the wrong verdict screen, not an access hole.

## Mechanism (objectui `1fb1ced36243`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: `const { appName } = useParams();` — the URL segment, which may be a package id; the probe effect calls `probe.call(dataSource, appName)` with it.
- `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` `probeAppAccess(appName)` → `probeMetaItemAccess('app', appName)` → the by-name route, which keys on the app NAME. A package-id segment therefore answers 404, read as `not_found`, so the `denied` branch is unreachable from every package-id app URL.

## Where the fix lands

Either the console resolves the segment to an app name before probing (the member's app list does not carry withheld apps, so it cannot do that from the list alone), or the backend's by-name app read also answers for the package id. Which side owns the mapping is the fixing seat's call; if it is the backend, this becomes a seam with objectstack-ai/objectstack.
